research_questions.teacher_geometry_value: Does teacher-consensus geometry improve the compact writer verifier?
research_questions.stability_weighting_value: Does script-stability weighting improve over otherwise identical unweighted teacher geometry distillation?
research_questions.wgc_comparison: Does STGD outperform the previously established WGC regularizer?

unweighted_tgd.name: Unweighted Teacher Geometry Distillation
unweighted_tgd.purpose: Measure the value of teacher consensus geometry without script-stability weighting

stgd.name: Script-Stable Teacher Geometry Distillation
stgd.purpose: Measure whether cross-script teacher agreement improves geometry distillation

shared_student_initialization: Same MoCo epoch-20 compact ResNet18 initialization
shared_writer_supervision: Same Arabic metric plus cross-script metric objective used by the Notebook 23 matched control
checkpoint_selection: Best selection cross-script macro AUC, followed by pooled AUC, lower EER, then earlier epoch

gamma_calibration.reason: Match distillation gradient scale without using selection AUC or EER

primary_comparisons.unweighted_tgd_vs_control: Tests whether teacher geometry itself transfers
primary_comparisons.stgd_vs_unweighted_tgd: Tests incremental value of script-stability weighting
primary_comparisons.stgd_vs_wgc: Tests whether teacher-guided geometry improves over self-consistency regularization

weighting_component_interpretation.supported: STGD exceeds unweighted TGD and the advantage is later directionally consistent across seeds
weighting_component_interpretation.not_supported: STGD does not outperform unweighted TGD
